In the upcoming Pro A game between Cholet and Chalon/Saone, scheduled for October 17 at 12:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Cholet and Chalon/Saone combine to score 168 or more points in this game.

If the combined total is less than 168, this market will resolve to "Under".

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods. This market will resolve according to the official final score published on lnb.fr.
